description: List All Possible Change Event Statuses for a Specified Company

data.description: Paginated list of change event statuses for the company.

id.description: Unique identifier of the change event status. Use as the {id} path parameter to update or delete the status.

default.description: Indicates whether this is a built-in default status (one of open, closed, void, or pending) rather than a custom company status.

default_status.description: Indicates whether this status is the company's default status applied to new change events.

deletable.description: Indicates whether this change event status can be deleted.

name.description: Display name of the change event status.

show_in_select.description: Indicates whether this status appears in the status selection dropdown.

mapped_to_status.description: Underlying canonical status this status maps to, which determines how it behaves in change event workflows.
